target.name: BotBuilt
target.founder: Barrett Ames, Colin Devine, Brent Wadas

methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $12M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
BotBuilt is a seed-stage company in Housing & Construction founded by Barrett Ames, Colin Devine, and Brent Wadas. The company has raised $12.4M to date. The relevant comp universe consists of five private peers operating in adjacent construction and housing technology spaces: Apis Cor, Unlimited Industries, Ground Control Development, ADMARES, and Hedral. No public comparables exist in this segment.

The Stage-Progression method was applied as the primary valuation approach, using total capital raised of $12.4M as a proxy for implied seed-stage value. A 2.5x step-up multiplier—representative of typical progression from seed to Series A funding—yields an implied valuation of $31M. This method is applicable given BotBuilt's seed stage and the absence of sufficient revenue or profitability data to support earnings-based approaches.

The triangulated valuation range is $26M (low) to $36M (high), with a median of $31M. The relatively narrow band reflects reliance on a single methodology; broader triangulation would require additional data on comparable company valuations, BotBuilt's revenue metrics, or market sizing inputs. Key uncertainties include market acceptance of the company's offering within the fragmented construction sector, the accuracy of the 2.5x multiplier as applied to this specific subsector, and the composition and stage distribution of the private peer set.
